name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audit a website for AI-discoverability and on-site engagement problems — crawlability, JS-render gaps, missing/invalid structured data, facts locked in non-text, stale or uncorroborated facts, entity ambiguity, weak on-site orientation / no context retention — and produce a report of findings with evidence and severity, plus prioritized actionable fixes and proactive improvements. Entrypoint skill composes specialist sensors across the marketplace into a unified Draft-07 audit report.
